name: ps-cached-assembly-direct-node-file-plant
body: The ps cached-assembly full-load-fallback case writes its durable node file directly on disk, matching the splice end-to-end fixture, rather than through apg node add, because the fixture gitignores the whole apg layout and the fallback is driven by the on-disk layers tree. Upgrade to the CLI write path if direct node-file authoring is ever disallowed in tests.
